c74object.name: evi_lib
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_lib.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_lib.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
The evi_lib.genexpr file also requires:
evi_adaa.genexpr
evi_biquads.genexpr
evi_clip.genexpr
evi_crossovers.genexpr
evi_dynamics.genexpr
evi_overdrive.genexpr
evi_polyblep.genexpr
evi_rcfilters.genexpr
evi_reverb_library.genexpr
evi_saturators.genexpr
evi_svfs.genexpr
